title: Fantastic Hardware Counters and How to Find Them: Automating the Detection of Noise-Resilient Performance Counters in HPC
problem: Hardware performance counters are noisy and unreliable for performance modeling on HPC systems
motivation: Accurate performance models require noise-resilient counters, but manual selection is tedious and system-dependent
method: Automated tool that: builds experimental setup, runs repeated experiments, analyzes counter noise patterns, ranks counters by resilience
key_novelty: Automated detection and ranking of noise-resilient hardware counters with systematic noise analysis methodology
contributions: Noise resilience metrics and ranking system
Tool with graphical and console interfaces
